Kalo denger kata #GirlBoss apa yg kamu pikirin? 
Tunjukkin yuk transformasi fashion atau makeup kamu yg mewakili arti #GirlBoss untukmu!


Hadiah: 1 gaun dari koleksi TikTok | At Vezzo untuk 10 orang pemenang
Due: 6 Juli 2021 - 11 Juli 2021
Kategori: Fashion & Make Up Transition 




Cara Ikutan: 
1️⃣ Upload video transisi fashion atau make-up yg mewakili arti #GirlBoss buat kamu.
2️⃣ Wajib menggunakan hashtag #GirlBoss dan mention @atvezzo pada caption.
3️⃣ Kamu boleh post video sebanyak-banyaknya agar kesempatan menang semakin besar!
4️⃣ Pastikan akun TikTok kamu tidak di-Private
5️⃣ Video tidak boleh mengandung unsur SARA, pornografi, atau menyinggung seseorang/kelompok tertentu.

stickerText: Real rural China

contents.desc: What is rural China like? I often got asked this question, and I’m happy that I have a chance to post about it. It’s not as modern and new as the cities, but it’s peaceful, and people’s lives are getting better and better every year. I appreciate it. #china #rurallife #ruralchina #visitchina #visitasia

item.desc: I honestly think these are the moments my mum and stepdad will remember most about China. Not the famous places, but the kindness of complete strangers and the warmth of everyday life. And if there’s one thing I hope you take away from this channel, it’s an appreciation for that side of the country I’m proud to call home.
